items.description: Federal investigators suspect an executive at a United States consulting firm helped ShinyHunters operate a website used to pressure hacked companies into paying ransom demands. items.title: WP2Shell Attack Lets Hackers Create WordPress Admin Accounts and Install Web Shells Without Login
items.description: WP2Shell combines two WordPress Core flaws to move from an unauthenticated request to server-side code execution. It can let an attacker create an administrator account and install a plugin-based web shell. Seqrite’s October 16 analysis lists affected releases, but does not establish widespread live exploitation. The report says the flaws were disclosed in July 2026. […] The post WP2Shell Attack…

items.description: Hackers are using generative AI to build custom malware, rewrite harmful scripts, and make phishing messages harder to spot. The campaign, called Midnight Mimosa, targets low-cost devices and gives attackers system access without requiring owners to download a harmful app or click a suspicious link.
